description:
Saphale, 22nd July 2026

As part of its community outreach initiative, the Rotary Club of Mumbai MaKaBo distributed essential items to students of the Zilla Parishad School in the Rodkhad and Kanderpure villages of Saphale.

The Club distributed 45 raincoats, 10 umbrellas, pens, biscuits, and water bottles to support the children during the monsoon season and encourage their educational journey. The students received the items with great enthusiasm, and their smiles reflected the positive impact of this thoughtful initiative.

The teachers and school staff expressed their heartfelt appreciation to the Club for addressing the children's basic needs with care and compassion. This initiative reinforced Rotary's commitment to serving underprivileged communities and bringing hope and happiness to young lives.
